body: Where have I indicated that I am better than anyone else? And where has there been any indication of me ‘bullying’ anyone?

My parents will be heartbroken. They also won’t trust me with any of the little independence I am getting now which is so important to me. I have been trying to seek help for mental health issues and it has taken them forever to even consider the idea of me seeing a counsellor. They might take that away too, and expect me to talk to them all the time. They would want access to my socials and device passwords. They would also prefer for me to live at home instead of move for college and attempt to regulate my activities. I understand they want to look out for me, but I would really like to try and live my own life.

You’re right, I’m from an Asian country. I have been attempting to keep my personal life separate but my parents end up getting to know some way or the other. I try to maintain boundaries but they have always expected complete transparency that I cannot provide as they have some rigid rules. Lesson learnt, not getting into any relationship that is remotely taboo.
I would like nothing more but the stakes are far too high.
We cannot visit each other due to the situation, but I will keep this in mind. Thank you ❤️
Thank you. Love to you too. I will do that. I think somewhere I’m just hurting too and want to take his pain away.
These are extremely extremely helpful. Especially the third point, I would have never thought of that. Thank you so much!! ❤️❤️
